Madhusudhan P

                                      Bangalore, India | +91 96425 68944 | madhu57330@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/madhu2p-1698/

SUMMARY

Generative AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience building end-to-end AI systems using agentic architectures, RAG, and custom GPTs. Skilled in deploying scalable ML applications on AWS and Azure, and integrating LLMs into real-world workflows through prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and multi-agent systems. Proficient with LangChain, LangGraph, and backend API development for production-ready GenAI solutions.

SKILLS

Technical Expertise: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, CNNs, RAG

Programming Languages & Frameworks: Python, SQL, Tensorflow, Keras, Pytorch, Scikit-Learn, FastAPI

Cloud Platforms: Amazon Web Services(AWS)

MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Git.

Generative AI: Large Language Models(LLMS), Hugging Face Transformers, RAG, VectorStores and Retrievers, LangChain, Lang Graph, Agentic AI.

EXPERIENCE

Hexaware Technologies | Senior Data Scientist	03/2024 - Present

Developed a virtual assistant using OpenAI custom GPT to replicate an Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), automating lab and supply chain tasks such as inventory tracking, product catalog search, supplier order management, and stock-level monitoring. Built a scalable backend using AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. Designed effective prompt instructions to improve GPT response accuracy and ensured data integrity and privacy throughout the system.

Created a GPT-powered virtual assistant for sales teams to automate sales and supply chain support tasks, including customer account retrieval, visit scheduling, contact management, and order fulfillment tracking—bypassing manual navigation in CRM/ERP systems. Streamlined workflows through automated API calls, boosting efficiency. Designed effective GPT prompts to ensure accurate responses and smooth user interactions.

Designed and implemented a modular multi-agent orchestration framework using OpenAI GPT-4o, pydantic, and FastAPI, enabling intelligent task routing via a planner Agent and dynamically wired functional agents.

Performed comprehensive unit testing, validating agent-tool execution flow with stubbed API responses, planner-to-agent routing logic, and behavior under both positive and negative test scenarios.

Awone AI | Senior Data Scientist	07/2023 - 02/2024

Architected and deployed an AI-driven claims analysis system leveraging transformer-based LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral-8x), reducing open inquiries by 30%. Implemented scalable deployment on AWS Kubernetes for high availability and performance.

Developed a Q&A chatbot application to address warnings encountered by insurance claim processors, providing prompt and accurate responses to queries.

Implemented Large Language Models such as BART, Llama2, Vicuna, Mistral, and GPT models for enhanced Question-Answering and document summarization capabilities.

TCS | System Engineer	07/2019 - 12/2021

Developed a predictive model to forecast penalty claims from delayed claim processing using machine learning algorithms like Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Naive Bayes. Tackled challenges of imbalanced classification and high-dimensional data through p-value-based feature selection and sampling techniques.

Developed an automated CRM system within the supply chain domain using Python, Deep Learning, and NLP. Preprocessed customer queries and implemented BERT for intelligent ticket assignment based on historical data. Enhanced customer support by automating ticket creation for unresolved issues, improving overall response efficiency.

Implemented an intelligent ticket classification and assignment system, leveraging NLP to extract crucial information from customer queries and match them to appropriate handling teams.

Thomson Reuters | Data Science Intern	09/2022 - 05/2023

Implemented forecasting models on time series data that help in predicting the future instances required in different clouds to analyze the cost for business management.

Developed a custom deep neural network for the FairFace Detection Challenge, achieving 78% accuracy in race, gender, and age classification with balanced performance across demographic groups.

EDUCATION

Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore	07/2021– 05/2023

MTech- CSE with Specialization in AI & ML	CGPA:8.42

CERTIFICATIONS

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)
